historyRefs.scope: Complete legacy Shoes/Backgear/Handgear/Seating partition, 48/48 exact legacy hashes
historyRefs.note: Immutable prior shard preserves every item-specific legacy decision and evidence. Those REWORK decisions apply only to their exact old hashes and do not transfer to the new replacements below.

summary.nextReviewPriority: Any newer exact hashes for these items supersede these decisions. Next prioritize fresh Seating 1-6/11-12 and Shoes 7-12, then Backgear/Handgear replacements.

reviews.name: Sneakers
reviews.reason: Paired three-quarter sneakers remain clear at card scale; layered chunky soles, laces, stitching, iridescent panels and raised aqua wave accents create convincing material depth while keeping Tier 1 simple and readable.

reviews.name: Slip-Ons
reviews.reason: Canvas slip-on identity is immediate; stitched uppers and sole depth are tangible, while raised multicolor buttons and drawn paint marks communicate Art Attack without becoming a flat badge. The pair stays distinct and legible at card size.

reviews.name: High-Tops
reviews.reason: Tall padded high-top silhouette, laces, panel seams and layered soles read physically at both scales. Purple leather-like panels, metallic toe treatment and restrained gold star hardware communicate Star Luxe without excessive tier spectacle.

reviews.name: Bow Shoes
reviews.reason: Large satin bows remain readable over structured dark uppers, while cyan/magenta inset sole lighting and floor spill give real Midnight Neon depth. The shoe pair is physically coherent, distinct from the other replacements and card-readable.

reviews.name: Boots
reviews.reason: Chunky ankle-boot construction, deep tread, padded collars, laces/eyelets and layered panels are convincing. Pastel synthetic-leather surfaces and translucent candy-like hardware make Candy Core specific while preserving clean card-scale recognition.

reviews.name: Runners
reviews.reason: Rugged runner identity is immediate: breathable mesh, reinforced overlays, real lacing and deep cushioned tread provide material depth. Muted trail colors and subtle compass/map geometry communicate Adventure Club without relying on a flat emblem.

reviews.name: Lounge Chair
reviews.reason: Rounded lounge-chair silhouette is unmistakable at card scale; segmented cushioning, upholstery seams, wood legs and contact shadow provide convincing soft-body/material depth. The ivory-lilac Cloud Pop treatment remains distinct and appropriately richer for Tier 3.

reviews.name: Bubble Seat
reviews.reason: Transparent spherical shell, dimensional blue cushions and a pixel-lit physical base make the Bubble Seat category obvious and Pixel Party specific. Refraction, occlusion and grounded lighting survive card reduction and differ clearly from the other chairs.

reviews.name: Art Stool
reviews.reason: Adjustable stool construction reads immediately through the round upholstered seat, spring/hardware and tripod supports. Berry-red fabric and berry embossing deliver Berry Blast without losing the functional stool silhouette; materials and lighting are dimensional at both scales.

reviews.name: Pod Chair
reviews.reason: Deep egg/pod shell, wood interior, layered sage cushions and built-in light establish a convincing Tier-4 chair. Floral/vine details communicate Garden Glow through structure and materials rather than background color; silhouette is unique and card-readable.

handoff.06: Preserve Seating 7-10 exact accepted hashes. The four-item recipe passed independent review, so Seating 11-12 may proceed under the current assignment.
